name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions (Barium fork).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool result (or a long input) is still needed verbatim; below it the item is truncated.

keepCallThreshold.title: Keep-call threshold
keepCallThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a call line stays when its result goes. Lower than keepThreshold so calls are dropped only when Jev is fairly sure.

truncateInputChars.title: Input truncation
truncateInputChars.description: Inputs longer than this get a third Jev question and are cut to this head when stale. 0 disables.

alwaysKeepCall.title: Always keep call (JSON array of regex)
alwaysKeepCall.description: Tools whose call line is never dropped; result and input still shrink. A compacted session must still know what it wrote, ran and sent.

alwaysKeepResult.title: Always keep result (JSON array of regex)
alwaysKeepResult.description: Tools whose result stays verbatim and is not asked about: paid or unrepeatable.

truncateTailChars.title: Truncated tool result tail
truncateTailChars.description: Characters at the end of a truncated tool result kept after the note, so a command's verdict line survives.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history; below it the built-in summary runs.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: TypeSafe Jev model name. Pinned; thresholds are tuned per version.
